notes_sections.heading: Recurring-repost pattern — TechniPros, LLC
items: TechniPros, LLC continues to repost the same two role templates (a "DevOps Engineer"-titled Senior DevOps Engineer role, and a "DevOps Engineer"-titled DevSecOps Engineer role) with a new job-detail ID and a rotating on-site multi-city list every few days: seen 2026-09-19 (IDs 3d6389da, a0acae92, 06ab958a), 2026-09-21 (IDs 715868bc, 06ab958a), and now 2026-09-22 (IDs 450177b2, 45ba9f6d). Content, required skills, W-2/No-C2C terms, and scoring are unchanged each time. Both are treated as the same recurring decision under the automatic-filing dedup rule (employer + exact role) and were not re-filed — applications.md already carries 4 Skipped rows for this exact pattern.

Worth flagging to Marc directly: if TechniPros keeps reposting under new job IDs indefinitely, this source will keep resurfacing the identical two postings on every run without ever producing a new candidate — low marginal value from this employer going forward unless the on-site requirement changes.
